documents.unit: Office of Academic Standards, Undergraduate Academic Code of Honor
documents.title: Generative AI Policy for Students (August 2023)
documents.quality_note: Official student-facing policy: unauthorized or not-expressly-permitted generative AI use is an Honor Code violation.

documents.unit: Office of Academic Standards, Undergraduate Academic Code of Honor
documents.title: Statement on Generative AI and Academic Integrity (May 2023)
documents.quality_note: Official statement giving faculty authority over AI use and describing student responsibility and procedures. Overlaps with the student policy but adds the faculty-authority and procedure content.

documents.unit: Office of Academic Standards, Undergraduate Academic Code of Honor
documents.title: Policy Update: AI Editing Tools (Fall 2024)
documents.quality_note: Short policy update: a prohibition on gen AI covers AI editing tools such as Grammarly unless stated otherwise; notes on AI detectors and attribution.

documents.unit: Office of Academic Standards, Undergraduate Academic Code of Honor
documents.title: AI Recommendations for Instructors
documents.quality_note: Instructor recommendations with four sample syllabus statements (prohibit, permit with reproducible attribution, etc.).

documents.title: Establishing AI Policies for Your Course (Syllabus Policy Language)
documents.quality_note: Teaching-center guide to writing AI syllabus policies, aligned with the Honor Code policy.

documents.unit: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
documents.title: CSE Guide to the Honor Code
documents.quality_note: Department honor-code guide with worked ChatGPT examples (explain quicksort OK vs. copy-pasted code), citation and consulting rules; AI is a large part of an otherwise general collaboration document.

notes: No college-level (College of Engineering) AI policy found. Notre Dame Learning pages (learning.nd.edu) and alresources.nd.edu overlap the Honor Code pages; alresources.nd.edu was fetched but not kept as it mostly lists other pages. www.nd.edu/... versions of the Honor Code sub-pages 404; honorcode.nd.edu versions used.
